metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Apparel - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly apparel for your team. Soft, durable blends perfect for embroidery or screen printing. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly blends combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester, making them a top choice for corporate uniforms, team gear, and promotional giveaways. This fabric holds vibrant screen-printed logos well and offers a comfortable fit for all-day wear. Whether you need custom hoodies for a safety crew or branded tees for a company picnic, cotton poly apparel delivers lasting value and a professional look.
